# Vennila Sooben

> Montréal-based software developer specializing in AI-assisted workflow automation with code, low-code, and no-code tools.

Canonical profile: https://vennilasooben.dev/

## Professional focus

- Software development with TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Vue 3, Nuxt, and React
- Workflow automation with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI, and Copilot Studio
- Power Apps automation catalog for executive assistants at iA Financial Group
- UdeM Technical Assistant experience developing LLM applications with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LangChain, and CrewAI
- Process analysis, accessible frontend systems, design systems, and technical delivery

## Current context

Vennila is an M.Sc. Computer Science student at Université de Montréal. At iA Financial Group, she designed and built a Power Apps catalog where executive assistants could discover and launch reusable Power Platform automations. As a Technical Assistant at Université de Montréal, she develops LLM applications using RAG, LangChain, and CrewAI. Her research separately examines reusable prompt patterns through large-scale prompt analysis, taxonomy design, and specification.
